title: GitHub Provider Operation Receipt v1
description: Canonical operation receipt for GitHub provider operations. Records metadata and operation outcome, never raw content, tokens, or credentials. Content-light by design: request/response bodies are hashed, fields reference hashed identifiers.

operation_id.description: Stable identifier for this operation instance.

auth_state_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the auth state record at operation time.

request_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the serialized request payload. Never the raw request body.

response_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the serialized response payload. Never the raw response body.

repository_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the repository identifier. Never the raw repo full name or ID.

actor_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the user or installation actor.

refusal_code.description: Machine-readable refusal code. Empty string if allowed/completed.

content_light.description: True if this receipt contains only hashes and metadata.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this receipt was generated.

trace_id.description: Optional distributed trace identifier for joinability across surfaces. Content-light: no raw secrets, paths, or prompts.

receipt_id.description: Optional self-referential receipt SHA-256 identifier. Format: 'sha256:' + 64 hex chars.

parent_trace_id.description: Optional parent trace identifier for causal chain ancestry.
